flags: Enerflex announced a major Engineered Systems award to design, engineer, fabricate and assemble over one gigawatt of behind-the-meter gas-fired power generation units for a North American data center. Its backlog of such units now exceeds 1.75 gigawatts, with deliveries through 2028.
Per the CFO, Enerflex completed the divestiture of the majority of its Asia Pacific operations during the third quarter of 2026. The exact date, price and terms are not in the cited text.
The Board approved an increase of about 17% in the quarterly dividend to $0.035 per common share, effective with the dividend payable in November 2026.
